title: MCP servers can now ship skills, run tasks, and more with Claude
summary: MCP servers can now publish skills alongside tools, with Skills over MCP in public beta so skills load on demand and update with the server. Tasks (background long jobs) and Elicitation (pausing for user sign-off or input) are now generally available, and File Uploads for sending PDFs, spreadsheets, and images to servers is rolling out soon. Because this is part of the open spec, other compatible clients should be able to support it as well.

title: Turn artifacts into Mac and Windows apps
summary: Artifacts can be installed as desktop apps on Mac and Windows via "Install as app" (beta), each getting its own icon and window, sharing support, and auto-updating when the artifact is edited. Three permission levels are offered: a browser-like default, app permissions for notifications and shortcuts, and full computer access, which lets artifacts act as everyday work tools such as calendar-driven meeting prep with reminders. It is available on all plans but not for HIPAA-ready orgs or hybrid deployments, and it requires internet access and sign-in.

title: Introducing Claude Ship
summary: Claude Ship is a system for handling pull requests after they are opened, made up of Code Review (generally available) plus PR Steward and Claude Approvals (beta). Running `/ship` in Claude Code pushes a change, opens a PR, and works through review and failing checks, while admins set review depth, timing, and spend limits per GitHub repo and an approval policy file can add observe-only mode and human sign-off for sensitive changes. It is available on Team and Enterprise with GitHub only, is not offered for ZDR, HIPAA configurations, or customer-managed keys, and Anthropic reports that merged PRs on its Claude Code team more than doubled from June to September while reverted changes fell over 40%.

title: Using a "chaos loop" to harden the Claude Docs launch: 60 server errors across billions of requests
summary: A post describes a two-week "chaos loop" in which Claude load-tested a staging cluster for the collaborative Claude Docs editor, broke components, and shipped fixes. The loop found a large doc using about 3 GB per pod, which copy-on-write reduced to about 180 MB, cutting estimated launch capacity from 500+ pods to about 50. The September 16, 2026 launch handled 4.6M+ docs in a week and 2 billion requests with 60 server errors and no rollbacks, at an estimated $125,000 inference cost.

title: The enterprise guide to securing coding agents
summary: Anthropic published a guide for security and technical leaders on securing Claude Code on Team and Enterprise plans, covering six evaluation questions, four risks (credential leakage, unvetted dependencies, data exfiltration, and prompt injection), and layered controls such as sandboxing, permission rules, and managed settings. Auto mode is now the default starting mode for interactive Claude Code sessions on all plans, while headless, Agent SDK, and HIPAA setups default to manual, and Enterprise plans gained scanning of skills and plugins for malicious content. The guide recommends piloting on a low-sensitivity repo before expanding.

title: Linked billing on the Claude Platform
summary: In beta, third-party platforms can bill customers' Claude API usage without sharing an API key. Customers link their Claude Platform org, approve each platform, set a spend limit, and can unlink at any time, while platforms no longer need to store or rotate keys or build their own metering, and can choose per request who pays. The caveat is that requests run in the platform's org, so customer IP allowlists, encryption keys, and retention settings do not apply.
